note: Copilot & AI #17. Needs the Teams setup policy Upload custom apps turned on for alex.demo a day before (it can take 24 h to apply). The API runs on the laptop in its own visible terminal window (the reminder screen shows it receiving the request), exposed by a dev tunnel; the API key is typed by the owner (a random string made off camera), never shown. No licence bought: custom actions work in Copilot Chat without usage-based billing. Never run pac auth. A screen that needs a second capture of another kind lists it under 'then'.
prepare: if (-not $env:VENDOR_API_KEY) { $env:VENDOR_API_KEY = Read-Host 'API key for the vendor API, same value as in the Developer Portal registration (owner types, not echoed)' -AsSecureString | ConvertFrom-SecureString -AsPlainText }

if (-not (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8080 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { $api = Start-Process python -ArgumentList '-m','vendor_api','--today','2026-11-21','--port','8080' -WorkingDirectory (Resolve-Path src).Path -PassThru; $env:MG_API_PID = $api.Id }
# manual (owner): devtunnel user login (device code, off camera); devtunnel host -p 8080 --allow-anonymous in a second terminal; curl the tunnel URL: 401 without the key, JSON with it

# manual (owner): Teams Developer Portal (dev.teams.microsoft.com/tools) as alex.demo, API key registration, New: name Contoso Vendor API, base URL = the tunnel URL, primary key = the same random key; note the registration id
if (-not $env:MG_TUNNEL_URL) { $env:MG_TUNNEL_URL = Read-Host 'dev tunnel URL, https://... (owner types, never shown)' }
if (-not $env:MG_APIKEY_REGID) { $env:MG_APIKEY_REGID = Read-Host 'API key registration id from the Developer Portal (owner types)' }

if (-not (Test-Path ./vendor-desk.zip)) { Push-Location src; python -m dakit package agent/appPackage --out ../vendor-desk.zip --app-id (python -c "import uuid;print(uuid.uuid4())") --api-url $env:MG_TUNNEL_URL --auth-id $env:MG_APIKEY_REGID --version 1.0.0; Pop-Location }

# manual (owner): Teams admin center, Teams apps, Setup policies, Upload custom apps for alex.demo (24 h before); then as alex.demo Teams (web), Apps, Manage your apps, Upload an app, Upload a custom app, vendor-desk.zip

screens.name: tests
screens.note: Expected: 78 passed, 0 errors 0 warnings, then the schema error for manifestVersion 1.19, then 0 errors again after the undo.

screens.name: portal
steps: Developer Portal, Tools, API key registration, New
Name Contoso Vendor API, base URL = the dev tunnel URL, key typed off camera (field blank or masked on screen)
Save and show the registration id

screens.name: chat
steps: Teams, Apps, Manage your apps, Upload an app, Upload a custom app, choose vendor-desk.zip (episode folder)
Open Microsoft 365 Copilot (Copilot Chat), Agents, Contoso Vendor Desk
Ask: Which renewals need a decision in the next 60 days?

Record the real answer and the card (expected from the API with --today 2026-11-21: Fabrikam Cloud, decide by 2026-12-31); if the upload shows an error record the text; if the agent only appears with a licence record that
mask: Windows user name in the file picker path

screens.name: reminder
steps: In the Contoso Vendor Desk chat ask: Remind Jordan Demo to decide on Fabrikam Cloud on 1 December 2026.
Show the confirmation dialog, confirm, and show the answer with a reminder id like rem-0001
Show the API terminal window receiving the POST request next to the browser
mask: API key if it ever appears in the API terminal

teardown: # manual (owner): stop devtunnel host (Ctrl+C), devtunnel delete <tunnel id>, devtunnel user logout; Developer Portal: delete the API key registration; Teams: remove Contoso Vendor Desk; switch the Upload custom apps policy back if it was off; clear the shell history line that contains the key
prepare_local: $v = python -c "import sys; print(sys.version_info >= (3, 10))"; if ($v -ne 'True') { throw 'python 3.10 or newer must be on PATH as python' }
python -m pip install -r src/requirements.txt --quiet; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'pip install failed' }

if (-not (Select-String -LiteralPath src/agent/appPackage/manifest.json -Pattern '"manifestVersion": "1.30"' -SimpleMatch -Quiet)) { git checkout -- src/agent/appPackage/manifest.json }   # a take stopped half-way leaves manifestVersion 1.19
teardown_local: if (-not (Select-String -LiteralPath src/agent/appPackage/manifest.json -Pattern '"manifestVersion": "1.30"' -SimpleMatch -Quiet)) { git checkout -- src/agent/appPackage/manifest.json }   # a take stopped half-way leaves manifestVersion 1.19
